description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

A well-funded, seed-stage B2B SaaS startup in the supply chain integrations space is looking for a Founding Software Engineer to help shape the architecture, culture, and product direction of an agentic integrations platform. This is a high-ownership role where you'll work across the full stack and have a direct impact on the company's trajectory from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and evolve the integrations platform — including mapping, testing, retries, queues, observability, and the full infrastructure layer.

 - Work across the entire stack: frontend (TypeScript, React), backend (Node.js), infrastructure (AWS), and LLM/agentic workflows.

 - Own projects end-to-end, from initial specs through implementation to measurable customer impact.

 - Help define product direction, engineering culture, and company-building decisions as an early team member.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required:

 - 3+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in fast-paced startup environments.

 - Demonstrated experience building products 0→1, either at an early-stage startup or through serious side projects.

 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React for frontend, and Node.js for backend.

 - Experience integrating or building workflows around large language models (LLMs) and agent-based platforms.

 - Hands-on experience with AWS for cloud infrastructure and PostgreSQL for data storage.

 - Experience owning end-to-end feature development across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.

 - Familiarity with observability, monitoring, distributed tracing, and reliable retry/queuing patterns in distributed systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals.

Nice to Have:

 - Experience in supply chain, logistics, or enterprise integration domains (EDI, ERP, WMS, TMS, etc.).

 - Familiarity with Vercel and Tailwind CSS.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $130,000 – $200,000 USD annually

 - Visa sponsorship available

 - Early-stage equity opportunity as a founding team member


LOCATION

This is an on-site role based in San Francisco, CA. Candidates must be willing to work from the San Francisco office.
